text:
Jordan Eng: Heads-up 0% I'll be in Sydney for ~6 weeks (Aug 2Sep 13) to help family. How does this affect the WFH stipend and payroll/tax/benefits?
Maya HR: Thanks Jordan. Please submit the temporary-remote form and mark the country as Australia. Stipend: if travel >30 days we prorate and consider temporary housing allowance separately.
Jordan Eng: Submitted form (ID TRF-2042).
hr-bot: Received: temporary-remote-form TRF-2042 submitted by Jordan Eng. People Ops will review within 48 hours.
Ken (Payroll): Quick notes: Australia has superannuation rules and PAYG withholding if payroll is shifted locally. For <90 days it's usually fine to remain on US payroll, but we need to verify the exact dates and your activities (no local contracting). Are you staying on US bank deposit?
Jordan Eng: Yes, US bank, continuing same benefits. No client meetings under an Australian entity.
Priya (Legal): Generally short stays <= 90 days for telework don't create a permanent establishment/compulsory payroll, but Aus rules can be strict about social security (super). We'll confirm with local counsel. Avoid signing contracts in AU or providing local invoices.
Maya HR: For the stipend: the standard WFH allowance covers recurring home-office costs; temporary travel housing or coworking fees are handled as a travel stipend and may be taxable. If you'd like gross-up, let us know and we'll run numbers.
Ken (Payroll): I'll run this with our payroll vendor to confirm superannuation exposure. Also need to check if any fringe benefit tax (FBT) applies for employer-paid housing. I'll update by EOD Fri.
Priya (Legal): Looping in Aus counsel: @AusCounsel (external)  can you confirm (1) whether employer obligations trigger for a 6-week US-employee remote in NSW; (2) any visa/permit concerns for a US passport holder doing remote dev work.
AusCounsel (external): Short reply  NSW generally won't require local payroll registration for pure telework under 90 days if the employee remains employed and paid by the overseas employer. No special visa if entry is as a tourist and no local employment. Recommend documenting dates and duties. Employer-provided housing can create FBT exposure; check exemptions and valuation methods.
Jordan Eng: Thanks  useful. Anything I need to do before I leave?
Maya HR: Please set your out-of-country dates in Workday and attach TRF-2042. Confirm emergency contact. We'll also email a checklist (international health coverage top-up, local emergency numbers, IT VPN checklist).
Jordan Eng: Done in Workday and added emergency contact.
Ken (Payroll): Noted. If payroll vendor flags super/FBT we'll follow up with any forms. If gross-up requested, please tell Maya and indicate estimated housing cost.
Maya HR: If you pay for lodging/coworking yourself and request reimbursement, it may be treated as taxable expense. We'll include reimbursement policy in the checklist.
Priya (Legal): I'll circulate the counsel note and a short compliance one-pager for international remote stints (do's and don'ts).
Jordan Eng: Appreciate it, team. I'll keep working PST hours and avoid local contracting.
Maya HR: Safe trip! Post any changes to dates here. :airplane:
Jordan Eng: Will do  thanks everyone.
